title: Classic British Fry-Up
description: A hearty and comforting breakfast dish from the UK, combining crispy bacon, golden eggs, and fluffy sautéed potatoes.
instructions: Heat a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat and add the butter.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, fry the bacon slices in a separate pan until crispy.
Crack the eggs into the pan with the potatoes and scramble them together.
Serve the eggs and potatoes in a bowl, topped with crispy bacon.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or chives, if desired.
